abstract: This study investigates the association between targeted geopolitical protectionism and firm-specific stock price crash risk using the US–China trade dispute as a quasi-natural experiment. Employing a staggered difference-in-differences framework on Chinese listed firms, we document a significant positive association between tariff-induced trade frictions and crash risk. This relationship is underscored by elevated financial reporting opacity, exacerbated operational volatility, and tightened financial constraints, which collectively incentivize executives to suppress negative information. Conversely, managerial ability, robust corporate governance, and digital transformation attenuate this association. Cross-sectionally, this tail risk is more pronounced among large and state-owned enterprises, whereas state-led policy hedging mitigates it for high-tech firms. Furthermore, China’s retaliatory tariffs are positively associated with crash risk for domestic importers by inflating procurement costs. Crucially, highly integrated processing trade firms facing simultaneous bilateral exposure experience a non-linear exacerbation of risk due to dual macro-financial pressures: export revenue contraction coupled with intermediate input cost inflation. Collectively, our findings highlight how international geopolitical conflicts structurally amplify corporate agency problems and threaten macro-financial stability.

abstract: This paper evaluates the effect of in utero exposure to the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami on birth outcomes in Indonesia. Exploiting variation in the timing of exposure, we find that the probability of a successful pregnancy drops by 5.4 percentage points (pp), while miscarriages increase by 5.0 pp for those exposed in the first trimester of pregnancy. Gestation length shortens by 0.28 months, and the likelihood of preterm birth rises by 5.4 pp. We find suggestive evidence that post‐disaster health investments by households may have shielded later cohorts from harmful effects, while measures of maternal health and socioeconomic status have limited explanatory power. Our results suggest the importance of considering fetal loss as a first‐order cost in natural disasters and highlight that facilitating household investment in health through various policies may mitigate negative birth effects in the aftermath.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了2004年印度洋海啸的宫内暴露对印度尼西亚出生结局的影响。利用暴露时间上的变异，我们发现，对于妊娠头三个月暴露者，成功妊娠的概率下降5.4个百分点（pp），而流产增加5.0个百分点。妊娠期长度缩短0.28个月，早产的可能性上升5.4个百分点。我们发现有提示性证据表明，灾后家庭的健康投资可能使较晚出生的队列免受有害影响，而母亲健康和社会经济状况的测度解释力有限。我们的结果表明，将胎儿丢失视为自然灾害中的首要成本十分重要，并强调通过多种政策促进家庭健康投资可能减轻灾后对出生的负面影响。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Childbirth Effects of the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami
title_zh: 2004年印度洋海啸的生育影响

abstract: How do liquidity shocks affect drug sales? Building on prior work on search costs in pharmaceutical markets, we propose that liquidity constraints have a larger impact on drug sales for less recurring acute ailments than chronic ailments, which have steady consumption. We exploit demonetization in India in 2016 as a transitory negative liquidity shock. Units, value, and weight of acute drug sales experienced a relatively higher decline than those for chronic illnesses. Consistent with the search cost hypothesis, we find that the impact varies by close correlates of search, such as drug price dispersion, government‐mandated stock‐keeping, and availability of public health infrastructure. Our work contributes by showing how the constrained liquidity of households can have differential effects on the downstream market structure of retail drugs.
abstract_zh: 流动性冲击如何影响药品销售？基于先前关于药品市场搜寻成本的研究，我们提出，流动性约束对非复发性急性疾病药品销售的影响大于对具有稳定消费的慢性疾病药品销售的影响。我们利用2016年印度废钞政策作为一次暂时性负向流动性冲击。急性疾病药品销售的 units、价值和重量相较慢性疾病药品出现更大幅度下降。与搜寻成本假说一致，我们发现该影响随与搜寻密切相关的因素而变化，例如药品价格离散度、政府强制储备以及公共卫生基础设施的可获得性。我们的工作贡献在于表明家庭流动性受限如何对零售药品的下游市场结构产生差异化影响。
title: Liquidity Shocks and Drug Sales: Evidence From India
title_zh: 流动性冲击与药品销售：来自印度的证据

abstract: Switzerland is the archetypal financial safe haven, yet its bank deposits do not behave like one. Using Swiss National Bank data, we find no robust positive deposit response to geopolitical risk. The clearer response appears in custody portfolios. After a one-standard-deviation rise in European geopolitical risk, the non-resident equity share falls by 1.16 p.p. relative to the resident share after two years, while the bond and money-market share rises by 0.78 p.p. after one year and 0.68 p.p. after two years. Global geopolitical threats and acts generate opposite relative-share responses, a pattern consistent with precautionary de-risking.
abstract_zh: 瑞士是典型的金融避风港，但其银行存款的表现却并非如此。利用瑞士国家银行的数据，我们发现存款对地缘政治风险没有稳健的正向响应。更清晰的响应出现在托管投资组合中。在欧洲地缘政治风险上升一个标准差后，两年后非居民股票份额相对于居民份额下降1.16个百分点，而债券和货币市场份额在一年后上升0.78个百分点、两年后上升0.68个百分点。全球性地缘政治威胁与地缘政治行为对相对份额产生相反的响应，这一模式与预防性去风险相一致。
title: Where is the Swiss safe haven? Geopolitical risk, bank deposits and custody portfolios
title_zh: 瑞士避风港何在？地缘政治风险、银行存款与托管投资组合

abstract: We investigate whether topics emphasized in FOMC communication affect market inflation expectations beyond policy-rate decisions. Using Fed Chair statements from 2011 to 2026, we measure attention across six macroeconomic themes and examine meeting-day changes in the 5y-5y forward inflation break-even rate. Controlling for the two-year Treasury yield, we find that attention to supply-side risks raises inflation expectations, mainly through energy and supply-chain narratives, whereas demand-side attention has no significant effect. These findings suggest that market inflation expectations respond to risks emphasized in central bank communication, identifying narrative focus as a distinct monetary policy communication channel.
abstract_zh: 我们考察联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）沟通中强调的主题是否会在政策利率决定之外影响市场通胀预期。利用2011年至2026年美联储主席声明，我们衡量对六个宏观经济主题的关注度，并考察会议当日5年-5年远期通胀盈亏平衡率的变化。在控制两年期美国国债收益率后，我们发现对供给侧风险的关注会提高通胀预期，主要通过能源和供应链叙事实现，而对需求侧的关注则没有显著影响。这些发现表明，市场通胀预期会对央行沟通中强调的风险作出反应，从而将叙事焦点识别为一种独立的货币政策沟通渠道。
title: FOMC Supply-Side Communication and Long-Term Inflation Expectations
title_zh: FOMC供给侧沟通与长期通胀预期

abstract: We study the effect of digital infrastructure on household energy poverty. We develop a theoretical framework in which digital infrastructure reduces labor-market and information frictions, raising household income and improving access to modern energy technologies. Using the rollout of China’s largest national digital infrastructure program, the Broadband China Pilot (BCP) policy, and multiple micro-household tracking datasets, we find that the policy alleviates household energy poverty by approximately 2.7 percentage points in treated cities. The effect operates mainly through higher off-farm income and improved access to modern energy equipment, and is stronger in poorer and more remote markets. A distinctive rural survey dataset shows that digital connectivity also benefits older households with limited off-farm employment opportunities through neighbor-assisted transfer arrangements involving adult children and nearby connected households, while generating village-level information spillovers in modern energy equipment adoption. The findings highlight the role of digital infrastructure in promoting household energy transition and reducing energy poverty.
abstract_zh: 我们研究数字基础设施对家庭能源贫困的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中数字基础设施降低劳动力市场和信息摩擦，提高家庭收入并改善对现代能源技术的获取。利用中国最大的国家数字基础设施项目“宽带中国”试点（BCP）政策的推广以及多套微观家庭追踪数据集，我们发现该政策使受处理城市的家庭能源贫困缓解约2.7个百分点。该效应主要通过更高的非农收入和改善对现代能源设备的获取发挥作用，并且在更贫困和更偏远市场中更强。一套独特的农村调查数据集显示，数字连接还通过涉及成年子女和附近已联网家庭的邻里协助转移安排，使非农就业机会有限的老年家庭受益，同时在现代能源设备采用方面产生村级信息溢出。研究结果凸显了数字基础设施在促进家庭能源转型和减少能源贫困方面的作用。

abstract: This paper analyzes optimal portfolio allocation in defined contribution pension schemes under joint exposure to mortality and financial jump risks. We develop a continuous-time framework in which both mortality intensity and financial asset prices follow jump–diffusion dynamics, extending standard pension models with continuous mortality and diffusion-based markets. The member’s objective combines expected terminal wealth maximization with downside risk control via Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), generating a time inconsistent stochastic control problem. We reformulate the problem as a bilevel optimization structure: for a fixed CVaR threshold, the inner problem reduces to a standard stochastic control problem, while the outer problem becomes a one-dimensional convex minimization. Using inf-convolution regularization and a probabilistic gradient representation derived from Feynman–Kac theory, we establish existence, uniqueness, and differentiability properties of the value function, thereby ensuring analytical tractability of the model. These results provide a rigorous foundation for numerical implementation through semi-Lagrangian schemes combined with gradient-based optimization. Numerical experiments quantify the impact of mortality jumps and mortality-linked derivatives on optimal portfolio policies. In particular, short-maturity longevity derivatives enhance downside protection, and appropriately structured hedging of mortality jump risk improves tail risk measures without reducing expected terminal wealth.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在同时面临死亡风险和金融跳跃风险的情况下，确定缴费型养老金计划中的最优投资组合配置。我们构建了一个连续时间框架，其中死亡强度与金融资产价格均服从跳跃—扩散动态，从而在连续死亡率和基于扩散的市场方面拓展了标准养老金模型。成员的目标将期望终端财富最大化与通过条件风险价值（CVaR）进行的下行风险控制相结合，形成了一个时间不一致的随机控制问题。我们将该问题重新表述为双层优化结构：对于固定的CVaR阈值，内层问题简化为标准随机控制问题，而外层问题则变为一维凸最小化问题。利用下卷积正则化以及由Feynman–Kac理论导出的概率梯度表示，我们建立了值函数的存在性、唯一性和可微性性质，从而确保了模型的解析可处理性。这些结果为通过半拉格朗日格式结合基于梯度的优化进行数值实现提供了严谨基础。数值实验量化了死亡率跳跃和死亡率关联衍生品对最优投资组合策略的影响。特别地，短期限长寿衍生品增强了下行保护，而对死亡率跳跃风险进行适当结构化的对冲可在不降低期望终端财富的情况下改善尾部风险度量。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

title: When mortality jumps: optimal portfolio design for defined contribution pension schemes

abstract: Can heterogeneity in team members’ ability levels confer benefits that enable heterogeneous teams to outperform homogeneous teams even when the latter are more skilled on average? Or do less capable individuals, as in Benabou (1996), drag down the productivities of more capable ones? This paper shows that, in aggregative games, such questions are fully tractable and that the answers depend on simple and economically interpretable conditions that weigh direct efficiency effects against individuals’ strategic adjustments to heterogeneity. The main results are qualitative and quantitative comparative statics results. The latter associate aggregate outcomes one-to-one with “diversity indices,” introduced here for the first time and shown always to exist given a reference population. These diversity indices turn out to be closely related to the inequality indices of Atkinson (1970) and Shorrocks (1980). In the main application to teamwork, heterogeneity in ability levels is shown to confer strategic benefits on teams under standard convexity assumptions.
abstract_zh: 团队成员能力水平的异质性是否能带来益处，使异质性团队即便在平均技能水平低于同质团队的情况下仍能超越后者？还是如贝纳布（1996）所述，能力较弱的个体会拖累能力较强者生产率？本文表明，在聚合博弈中，此类问题完全可处理，且答案取决于简单且具有经济学可解释性的条件，这些条件权衡直接效率效应与个体对异质性的策略性调整。主要结果是定性和定量比较静态结果。后者将聚合结果与“多样性指数”一一对应，该指数为本文首次引入，并证明在给定参照群体下始终存在。这些多样性指数与阿特金森（1970）和肖罗克斯（1980）的不平等指数密切相关。在针对团队合作的主要应用中，能力水平的异质性在标准凸性假设下被证明为团队带来策略性收益。
title: On the Strategic Benefits of Diversity in Teamwork and other Aggregative Games
title_zh: 论团队合作及其他聚合博弈中多样性的战略优势

abstract: The weakening of global multilateral mechanisms has opened space for regional and subregional level technical partnerships to function as adaptive governance mechanisms. This paper contends that these partnerships can function as adaptive governance mechanisms in a context where global multilateral cooperation is becoming ineffective. By applying the Political Economy Analysis (PEA) framework, we posit that regional and subregional technical partnerships offer a possible model for reimagining food and nutrition governance. These platforms have succeeded by prioritizing delivery on technical goals (e.g. locust control, healthy school meals), and inclusive leadership. Further, these bridging structures are less susceptible to the erosion of global-level multilateralism because they are grounded in the immediate economic and environmental realities faced by the member countries.
abstract_zh: 全球多边机制的弱化为区域和次区域层面的技术伙伴关系发挥适应性治理机制的作用开辟了空间。本文认为，在全球多边合作日趋失效的背景下，这些伙伴关系能够充当适应性治理机制。通过运用政治经济学分析（PEA）框架，我们提出，区域和次区域技术伙伴关系为重新构想粮食与营养治理提供了一种可能的模式。这些平台之所以取得成功，在于其优先落实技术目标（如蝗虫防治、健康学校供餐）以及包容性领导。此外，这些桥接结构较少受到全球层面多边主义侵蚀的影响，因为它们立足于成员国所面临的直接经济与环境现实。
title: Adaptive food and nutrition Governance: The Role of regional and subregional technical platforms and partnerships amidst a Crisis of multilateralism
title_zh: 适应性粮食与营养治理：多边主义危机中区域和次区域技术平台与伙伴关系的作用

abstract: The gig economy has profoundly reshaped the labour market landscape, fostering new employment forms, expanding overall employment capacity, and enhancing income stability and economic resilience for a broad workforce, which mitigates gig workers’ vulnerability to economic shocks. This study empirically examines the gig economy’s impact on crime rates using a quasi-natural experiment of food delivery platforms’ staggered entry into 209 Chinese cities and criminal conviction data from judicial adjudicative documents. The findings demonstrate that the entry of food delivery platforms into cities – a typical gig economy representative – significantly reduces crime incidence, with robbery, snatch, and theft cases and offenders falling by 8.29% and 10.30%, respectively. This effect is more pronounced in cities with a higher floating population share and lower labour-force participation rates, and for individuals with prior criminal records. Mechanism analysis reveals the gig economy’s crime-reduction effect primarily operates through longer working hours, higher income, and alleviated emotional distress. This emphasizes the direct influence of gig work on improving workers’ economic conditions, and its profound contribution to enhancing quality of life and generating positive social benefits, which are hard to quantify using traditional economic indicators.
abstract_zh: 零工经济深刻重塑了劳动力市场格局，催生了新的就业形态，扩大了整体就业容量，并增强了广泛劳动者群体的收入稳定性与经济韧性，从而缓解了零工劳动者对经济冲击的脆弱性。本研究利用外卖平台分批进入中国209个城市的准自然实验，并结合司法裁判文书中的刑事定罪数据，实证检验了零工经济对犯罪率的影响。研究发现，作为零工经济典型代表的外卖平台进入城市显著降低了犯罪发生率，抢劫、抢夺和盗窃案件及犯罪人数分别下降8.29%和10.30%。这一效应在流动人口占比较高和劳动力参与率较低的城市，以及有犯罪前科的个体中更为明显。机制分析表明，零工经济的减罪效应主要通过更长的工作时间、更高的收入和缓解情绪困扰发挥作用。这凸显了零工工作对改善劳动者经济状况的直接影响，以及其对提升生活质量和产生积极社会效益的深刻贡献，而这些效益难以用传统经济指标量化。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为209个中国城市的外卖平台进入与犯罪率，使用中国司法判决数据，核心背景和数据均属中国。
title: Impact of the gig economy on crime: a case study of food delivery platforms
title_zh: 零工经济对犯罪的影响：以外卖平台为例

abstract: This study provides new empirical evidence on the association between housing cost burden and food insecurity in the U.S. Leveraging nationally representative longitudinal data from the 2020–2023 Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP) and a Double Machine Learning (DML) framework, we examine whether housing cost burden is associated with multiple food insecurity and very low food security (VLFS) outcomes, and whether this association varies by tenure transition. When housing cost burden is defined as housing costs exceeding 30% of income, we find no relationship between housing cost burden and food insecurity after adjustment for observed pre‐treatment household characteristics. When a 50% threshold is used, however, housing cost burden is associated with higher binary food insecurity and food insecurity depth among households that remain non‐owners throughout the study period. Broadly consistent with previous work, stable homeownership appears to attenuate this association in some specifications. The association is also more apparent for broader food insecurity outcomes than for VLFS. These findings highlight the importance of housing‐burden severity and tenure status in understanding links between housing affordability and food hardship.
abstract_zh: 本研究为美国住房成本负担与粮食不安全之间的关联提供了新的经验证据。我们利用2020—2023年收入与项目参与调查（SIPP）的全国代表性纵向数据以及双重机器学习（DML）框架，考察住房成本负担是否与多种粮食不安全和极低粮食安全（VLFS）结果相关，以及这种关联是否因产权转换而异。当住房成本负担被定义为住房成本超过收入的30%时，我们在调整观察到的处理前家庭特征后，未发现住房成本负担与粮食不安全之间存在关系。然而，当采用50%阈值时，住房成本负担与在整个研究期间始终为非业主的家庭中更高的二元粮食不安全和粮食不安全深度相关。与以往研究大体一致，稳定的住房所有权在某些设定中似乎减弱了这种关联。这种关联在更广泛的粮食不安全结果上也比在VLFS上更为明显。这些发现凸显了住房负担严重程度和产权状况在理解住房可负担性与粮食困难之间联系方面的重要性。
title: Household Food Insecurity and Housing Stress
title_zh: 家庭食物不安全与住房压力

abstract: We investigate the impact of regional favoritism on educational attainment in Africa. Using geocoded, individual-level survey data from the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS), we show that men who grew up in areas geographically linked to a national leader attain higher levels of education later in life. In contrast, we observe no beneficial effects of geographical leader connections for women on average; only a subset of women who have additional ethnic ties and are possibly from wealthier families experience such effects. We interpret these results using a discrete choice framework that models decisions regarding whether children continue schooling based on perceived returns to education versus the costs of that education. This framework suggests that preferential educational policies are unlikely to be the primary cause of the higher attainment observed for men and the subset of women mentioned previously. Instead, educational choices appear to respond to expectations of local economic booms in geographically connected regions. Additional evidence, such as regarding the likelihood of skilled employment later in life, supports this interpretation.
abstract_zh: 我们考察区域偏袒对非洲教育 attainment 的影响。利用来自人口与健康调查（DHS）的带有地理编码的个体层面调查数据，我们表明，在 geographical 上与一位国家领导人相关联的地区长大的男性，日后会获得更高水平的教育。相比之下，平均而言，我们未观察到地理上的领导人关联对女性产生有益影响；只有一部分拥有额外族群联系、且可能来自更富裕家庭的女性才会经历此类效应。我们用一个离散选择框架来解释这些结果，该框架对有关儿童是否继续上学的决策建模，依据是对教育感知回报与教育成本的比较。这一框架表明，优惠性教育政策不太可能是所观察到的男性以及前述部分女性更高教育 attainment 的主要原因。相反，教育选择似乎是对地理上相连地区本地经济繁荣预期的反应。其他证据，例如关于日后获得技能型就业的可能性，支持这一解释。
title: Regional favoritism and educational attainment in Africa
title_zh: 非洲的地区偏袒与教育程度

abstract: This study examines how individuals’ strategic sophistication shapes social distancing during the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic, when distancing was a costly protective decision under two sources of risk: the private risk of infection and strategic uncertainty about whether others would comply. We develop a weakest-link public goods game with private costs of social distancing, in which agents differ in their level- k depth of reasoning about others. The model predicts that the probability of distancing rises with the level- k type when baseline compliance is low. We test this prediction using large-scale, nationally representative survey data that include incentivized experiments to measure participants’ level- k types. We find that a one-level increase in level- k lowers the probability of leaving home daily by 1.6 percentage points in Singapore and is associated with a 3.4 percentage-point lower probability of maintaining or increasing outdoor activity in South Korea.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察在COVID-19疫情早期阶段，个体的策略复杂度如何影响社交距离行为。当时，保持距离是一项代价高昂的保护性决策，面临两类风险：私人感染风险，以及关于他人是否会遵守的策略不确定性。我们构建了一个具有私人社交距离成本的最弱环节公共品博弈，其中个体在关于他人推理的k级深度上存在差异。模型预测，当基线遵守水平较低时，保持距离的概率随k级类型升高而上升。我们使用大规模、具有全国代表性的调查数据检验这一预测，数据中包含激励实验以测量参与者的k级类型。我们发现，在新加坡，k级每提高一级，每日离家概率降低1.6个百分点；在韩国，这与维持或增加户外活动的概率降低3.4个百分点相关。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Social distancing under strategic uncertainty: The role of strategic sophistication in the COVID-19 pandemic
title_zh: 策略不确定性下的社交距离：策略老练度在COVID-19疫情中的作用

abstract: Concerns abound that ‘killer acquisitions’ by tech giants could deter startup entry and stifle innovation. This column analyses patent data before and after 1,200 acquisitions by eight technology giants between 1995 and 2020. On average, the ‘Big Eight’ firms appear to invest in the acquired technology rather than kill it. Acquired inventions become more influential, more widely cited, and more embedded in follow-on innovation by both the acquirer and competitors. However, longer-term changes to the competitive landscape need further investigation.
abstract_zh: 人们普遍担忧，科技巨头的“杀手级收购”可能会阻碍初创企业进入并扼杀创新。本专栏分析了1995年至2020年间八家科技巨头进行的1200起收购前后的专利数据。平均而言，“八大”公司似乎对被收购技术进行投资，而非将其扼杀。被收购的发明变得更具影响力、被更广泛引用，并更深入地融入收购方和竞争对手的后续创新之中。然而，竞争格局的长期变化仍需进一步研究。
authors: Florian Ederer, Regina Seibel, Timothy S. Simcoe
title: What happens to innovation after Big Tech buys a startup
title_zh: 大型科技公司收购初创企业后创新走向如何

abstract: Emerging market capital flows remain highly sensitive to global shocks. This column analyses foreign investors in emerging market local-currency sovereign bonds depending on whether they are benchmarked to J.P. Morgan’s main local-currency government bond index or not. Benchmarked investors have increased their share of foreign holdings more than twofold over 2010–2025. Global push factors are strong determinants of benchmarked flows, whereas domestic pull factors determine non-benchmarked flows. Index design choices, such as country caps, can therefore materially affect flows to constituent countries.
abstract_zh: 新兴市场资本流动仍对全球冲击高度敏感。本专栏分析新兴市场本币主权债券的外国投资者，依据其是否以摩根大通主要本币政府债券指数为基准进行区分。2010—2025年间，基准投资者的外国持有份额增长逾两倍。全球推动因素是基准投资者资金流的强决定因素，而国内拉动因素决定非基准投资者资金流。因此，指数设计选择（如国家上限）可实质性影响流向成分国的资本流动。
authors: Serkan Arslanalp, Stijn Claessens, Daniela Klingebiel
title: Taming original sin redux: The role of benchmark-driven flows
title_zh: 驯服原罪再探讨：基准驱动流动的作用

abstract: Against the backdrop of increasingly demanding requirements for corporate sustainability, ESG has become an important dimension for assessing the level of high-quality corporate development. By shaping cognition, values, and decision-making capabilities, executives’ academic experience exerts a profound influence on corporate management and socioeconomic development. This study applies upper echelons theory and imprinting theory to a research sample of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2018 to 2023. It examines the relationship between executives’ academic experience and corporate ESG performance, as well as the mediating role of green technological innovation. The results suggest that executives’ academic experience is positively associated with corporate ESG performance. Green technological innovation mediates the relationship between academic experience and corporate ESG performance. This positive association is stronger in the environmental and social dimensions, and weaker in the governance dimension. Heterogeneity analysis shows that this association is more pronounced in state-owned enterprises and heavily polluting firms. This study provides new empirical evidence for understanding the relationship between executive characteristics and corporate sustainability. It offers valuable empirical support and policy implications for corporate talent management strategies as well as government innovation support policies.
abstract_zh: 在企业可持续发展要求日益提高的背景下，ESG已成为评估企业高质量发展水平的重要维度。高管学术经历通过塑造认知、价值观和决策能力，对企业管理和社会经济发展产生深远影响。本研究将高阶梯队理论和烙印理论应用于2018至2023年中国A股上市公司的研究样本，考察高管学术经历与企业ESG表现之间的关系，以及绿色技术创新的中介作用。结果表明，高管学术经历与企业ESG表现呈正相关关系。绿色技术创新在高管学术经历与企业ESG表现之间发挥中介作用。这种正相关关系在环境和社会维度上更强，在治理维度上较弱。异质性分析表明，这种关联在国有企业和重污染企业中更为显著。本研究为理解高管特征与企业可持续发展之间的关系提供了新的经验证据，为企业人才管理策略以及政府创新支持政策提供了有价值的经验支持和政策启示。

title: Executives’ academic experience and corporate ESG performance: evidence from Chinese listed firms
title_zh: 高管的学术经历与企业ESG表现：来自中国上市公司的证据

abstract: China’s ongoing policy-driven mergers and acquisitions of rural banks (M&A) are reshaping rural financial intermediation, yet little is known about whether such consolidation enhances economic resilience (ER). To fill this gap, we develop an analytical model to examine the relationship between rural bank M&A and county-level ER. Using a dataset of 2684 Chinese county-level administrative units over 2013–2023, we apply a staggered difference-in-differences framework. The results show that rural bank M&A significantly enhances county-level ER, with an estimated treatment effect of 0.100. This finding remains robust across multiple checks. Mechanism analysis suggests that increased banking concentration partially offsets resilience gains, while a narrower urban-rural income gap and improved agricultural production efficiency support them. Counties with stronger 4 G infrastructure exhibit a statistically significant positive effect, while the positive impact is also observed across the eastern, central, and western regions and for large, medium, and small cities. Further analysis shows that rural bank M&A improves ecological environment quality, with the positive M&A-ER interaction suggesting that consolidation mitigates the negative association between ER and environmental quality. Rural financial consolidation thus serves as a governance complement for sustainable county-level development, aligning banking reform with both ER and ecological goals.
